step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD for the voluntary leaving issue as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity case number] — voluntary leaving — [name of the employer] — [last day worked] — just cause not shown.”
Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the claim for benefits is active, terminated, blocked or archived:

ul.li: If the claim is active, go to step 3.

If the claim is terminated, but may be reactivated:
On the Terminated tab, select the appropriate BPC.
Select Reactivate .
Go to step 3.
If the claim is blocked or archived, go to step 6.

step.cmd: Determine if an MA is imposed to stop payments for the unreported voluntary leaving:
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to remove the MA and input the D11 as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Manual Action: Select the appropriate MA.
Disqualification: Select 11 - Voluntary leaving - Just cause not proven .
Effective: Enter the w/c for the voluntary leaving.
Message: Select 1 - An overpayment resulted due to a disqualification .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Disqualifications/Disentitlements (M161) transaction and input the D11 as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Disqualification: Select 11 - Voluntary leaving - Just cause not proven .
Effective: Enter the w/c for the voluntary leaving.
Message: Select 1 - An overpayment resulted due to a disqualification .

step.cmd: Determine the blocked claim’s CS by reviewing the Blocked Status column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If 1 - Updateable is displayed, go to step 7.
If 2 - Not blocked is displayed, return to step 2.
If any other CS is displayed, go to step 14.

step.cmd: Review the Blocked Action Pending column:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, go to step 8.
If all rows are blank, go to step 10.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Waiting for an updateable CS in BCS.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next business day.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, review the Blocked Action Pending column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, return to step 8.
If all rows are blank, go to step 10.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following fields:

ul.li: Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
C - Yes to clear the registration number
D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions

step.cmd: On the Disqualifications tab, input the D11 on the Disqualifications section as follows (up to 3 disqualifications in BCS can be imposed or rescinded):

ul.li: Type: Select 11 - Voluntary leaving - Just cause not proven .
Effective Week: Select the disqualification start date.
Message: Select 1 - An overpayment resulted due to a disqualification .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 13.
If the transaction shown is correct, Select Close and go to step 16.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Detection: Select the investigation type as displayed in NIIS.
Message: Select 1 - An overpayment resulted due to a disqualification .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim with the undeclared voluntary leave.
Earnings to be allocated: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 2: Type “ACS letter already sent.”
Remarks line 3: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 4: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the D-91-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Date claimant called or information sent (1542)

Indefinite disqualification - D11 or D10 - Post audit (2915)
Voluntary leaving - Post audit
We / We have reconsidered (2916)
Start date of disqualification - Sunday’s date (1294)
Text - Name of Employer(s) (1502)
Date of Event (1292)
No reply from claimant / reply received with an explanation / reply received with no explanation (2938)
False representation message / Number of omissions or false representations (2941): Select Blank .
Penalty message / Warning message (2950): Select Blank .

Overpayment messages (2452): Select the appropriate option:
Blank if there is no resulting overpayment
Overpayment - No misrepresentation and active claim
Overpayment - No misrepresentation and inactive claim

step.cmd: In NIIS, from Report of Investigation , select the Decision tab and complete the following fields:
Determine if the ROE is on file:

ul.li: If yes, in RCM, update the Special condition field to reflect the reconsideration decision on the RFS. Go to step 19.

step.cmd: Determine if a recalculation is required:
In NWS, determine if there is a CR Recalculation WI pending or unassigned in the related WIs for this BPC:
Create an AI WI as follows:

ul.li: End User: Select Next available user .

Comments: Type the appropriate option:
If a recalculation is required, type “Level 1 recalculation required — Integrity case [Integrity case number].”
If a recalculation is not required, type “Claim Review Recalculation WI — Integrity case [Integrity case number].”

Details: Type the appropriate option:
If a recalculation is required, type “A recalculation of BPC [DD-MM-YYYY] is required due to the adjudication of ROE [serial number]. A Level 2 ROD is on file and the reconsideration timeframe ends on [DD-MM-YYYY]. Recalculation inputs and notification to the client must be completed no later than this date.” If there is a CR Recalculation WI for the ROE under reconsideration, also type “Complete the Claim Review Recalculation work item related to this benefits period.”
If a recalculation is not required, type “Complete the Claim Review Recalculation work item related to this benefits period.”

step.cmd: Complete the CR Integrity WI.
